from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Separate the data by region
sub_saharan_data = merged_data_clean[merged_data_clean['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
lower_middle_income_data = merged_data_clean[merged_data_clean['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Perform linear regression for Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub_saharan = sub_saharan_data[['Education_Expenditure']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y_sub_saharan = sub_saharan_data['GDP'].values

model_sub_saharan = LinearRegression()
model_sub_saharan.fit(X_sub_saharan, y_sub_saharan)
coef_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan.coef_[0]
p_value_sub_saharan = model_sub_saharan.score(X_sub_saharan, y_sub_saharan)

# Perform linear regression for Lower Middle Income countries
X_lower_middle_income = lower_middle_income_data[['Education_Expenditure']].values.reshape(-1, 1)
y_lower_middle_income = lower_middle_income_data['GDP'].values

model_lower_middle_income = LinearRegression()
model_lower_middle_income.fit(X_lower_middle_income, y_lower_middle_income)
coef_lower_middle_income = model_lower_middle_income.coef_[0]
p_value_lower_middle_income = model_lower_middle_income.score(X_lower_middle_income, y_lower_middle_income)

coef_sub_saharan, p_value_sub_saharan, coef_lower_middle_income, p_value_lower_middle_income
